FILE 08 / NO JOKES HERE

Okay.
Jokes aside.

What we actually think about you.

Strong.

You stand firmly by your convictions. When you say or believe something, you stick to it—and that certainty is something we genuinely admire.

Caring.

You may not always express it by constantly reaching out, but when you care about someone, it is real and unmistakable.

Soft.

There is a quiet softness to you: shy in some rooms, lively and wonderfully fun when you feel comfortable.

Beautiful.

You may reject the compliments. Unfortunately for your case, the evidence remains overwhelming.

FILE 09 / LETTERS TO TUMININU

FROM PEOPLE
GLAD CAMP HAPPENED.

01

From Maroh

Happy birthday, Tumi!! I care about you, and I really hope this new year brings great things into your life.

I remember how we met—we were on toilet duties in camp (yuck). The day we actually spoke like friends was the day our platoon did Man O’ War drills. From there we became two camp peas in a pod—with Iwinosa occasionally becoming the third pea.

You still checked up on me whenever you had the chance. I care about you, and I want to wish you a big happy birthday.

— Maroh
02

From Iwinosa

It’s funny thinking that if not for Maroh and camp, I probably wouldn’t have met you. And now we’re here making an entire website for your birthday 😂.

You’re strong, caring and loving. And yes, you’re very, very beautiful.

I hope this new year is genuinely beautiful to you: more reasons to be happy, more places to go, good people around you, and memories you’ll look back on and smile.

— Iwinosa
